report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Rahul Sharma | Age: 60
Body Temperature at Scene: 23.3°C | Ambient Temperature: 23.9°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 13.5 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  2. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  3. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  4. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  5. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Carbon Monoxide, Ketamine

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
